description: ADK golden evaluation cases for Carbon Coach conversational agent

eval_cases.description: User mentions multi-activity travel by bus and AC usage

conversation.content: I travelled 12 km by bus today and used the AC for 4 hours.

assertions: Response mentions 1.07 or 1.068 kg CO2e for bus travel
Response mentions 4.26 kg CO2e for AC cooling
Total emission sum of 5.33 or 5.328 kg CO2e appears in reply
Greener alternative or thermostat advice presented

eval_cases.description: User specifies travel mode without distance; agent asks one short question without guessing

conversation.content: I took a taxi to the campus today.

assertions: Agent asks one short question requesting the distance in kilometers
Agent does not invent or assume distance or emission figures

eval_cases.description: User logs high activity exceeding the monthly 150 kg budget; tree offset plan triggered

conversation.content: I drove 1000 km by petrol car this month.

assertions: States user crossed monthly carbon limit by 20 kg
Provides tree-planting offset plan with ~21 kg CO2/tree/year
Gives two concrete reduction actions without shaming the user

eval_cases.description: User queries in Hindi; agent processes calculation and responds warmly in Hindi

conversation.content: आज मैंने 10 किमी बस की यात्रा की।

assertions: Mentions 0.89 kg CO2e calculated from tool

eval_cases.description: User queries in Telugu; agent processes calculation and responds warmly in Telugu
assertions: Mentions 0.45 kg CO2e calculated from tool

eval_cases.description: User asks how they did this week; agent calls get_summary

conversation.content: How did I do this week?

assertions: Reports totals and breakdown directly from tool result
